scope: Historical PX-OS-095 transition admission and current closure-evidence contradiction
authority_statement: This report records immutable historical facts and typed admission mappings. It does not rewrite events 251-254, does not claim that their receipt is current, and does not preserve PX-OS-095 closure against contradictory later evidence.

findings.claim: Four consecutive historical PX-OS-095 transitions contain generic evidence but omit the transition-specific admission fields now required by the authoritative reducer.

attestation_mapping.source_claim: Event 251 says the regenerated index was consumed by the owned test-section command.
attestation_mapping.qualification: Historical claim only; not evidence of current membership.

attestation_mapping.source_claim: Event 252 says the historical section receipt recorded 68 passed and 9 subtests passed.
attestation_mapping.qualification: Historical test result only; not a current verification receipt.

attestation_mapping.source_claim: Event 253 says the historical receipt input hash bound the refreshed membership index into that section execution.
attestation_mapping.qualification: Historical integration claim only; not a current index-membership proof.

attestation_mapping.source_claim: Event 254 says the historical managed pytest process exited zero and its workspace was reclaimed.
attestation_mapping.qualification: Historical process-lifecycle claim only; not current operational verification.

findings.claim: PX-OS-095 completion_evidence labels the receipt's internal receipt_sha256 as though it were the artifact SHA-256, while the actual current receipt bytes hash differently; the operational-ledger test population also changed after closure.

post_closure_change.basis: The ledger test file was materially extended after PX-OS-095 closed, including the append-only backfill regressions in this change. Therefore the historical testing-governance receipt cannot establish current test-population status.

findings.required_disposition: After full replay is restored, reopen PX-OS-095 under the same stable card and require current governed membership evidence before any later reclosure.
